ddl.name: climate_profiles_months_check
ddl.value: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("months") = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length("months") = 12 ELSE false END

ddl.name: items_tagged_complete_check
ddl.value: "status" NOT IN ('tagged', 'confirmed') OR ("category" IS NOT NULL AND "warmth_level" IS NOT NULL AND "waterproof" IS NOT NULL AND "windproof" IS NOT NULL AND "insulated" IS NOT NULL AND "formality" IS NOT NULL AND "condition" IS NOT NULL AND cardinality("seasons") > 0)

ddl.name: wear_logs_target_check
ddl.value: "item_id" IS NOT NULL OR "outfit_id" IS NOT NULL
